scripts.purgecss: npx purgecss --css src/styles/app.css --content "src/**/*.astro" "public/**/*.js" --safelist active dropdown-open fade-out --output ._purge_tmp && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.copyFileSync('._purge_tmp/app.css','src/styles/app.css');fs.rmSync('._purge_tmp',{recursive:true,force:true});"
